name: product-completeness-purchase-availability
description: Verifies all three premium-fist and premium-companion Game Passes plus all eight Developer Products are uniquely configured, live-price aware, wired, and server authoritative without opening a purchase prompt.

steps.label: allow bounded bootstrap and regional-price lookup

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG') local command=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation') command:Invoke('Reset') assert(cfg.StudioTestGrantPremium==false,'Studio purchase bypass must stay disabled') local unique={} local configuredFists,configuredPets,configuredProducts,honorProducts,worldStands=0,0,0,0,0 local expectedFists={['Crimson Vanguard Fist']=1947838143,['Stormbreaker Fist']=1951036123,['Celestial Titan Fist']=1951054054} for _,item in ipairs(cfg.PremiumFists) do local id=tonumber(item.gamePassId) or 0 assert(id==expectedFists[item.name] and id%1==0 and not unique[id],'premium fist ID missing, mismapped, or duplicated') unique[id]=true configuredFists+=1 local stand=root:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Stand',true) assert(stand and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false,'premium fist world stand unavailable') worldStands+=1 end for _,item in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local id=tonumber(item.gamePassId) or 0 assert(id>0 and id%1==0 and not unique[id],'premium pet ID missing or duplicated') unique[id]=true configuredPets+=1 local stand=root:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Premium Pet Stand',true) assert(stand and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false,'premium pet world stand unavailable') worldStands+=1 end local expectedHonor={HonorPouch25=3708804891,HonorCache90=3708804911,HonorVault300=3708804933,HonorTreasury850=3708804944} for _,item in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do local id=tonumber(item.productId) or 0 assert(id>0 and id%1==0 and not unique[id],'Developer Product ID missing or duplicated') unique[id]=true configuredProducts+=1 if item.shopPage=='Honor' then assert(id==expectedHonor[item.id] and item.worldOffer==false and (tonumber(item.honor) or 0)>0,'Honor product mapping is not exact') honorProducts+=1 else assert(item.worldOffer==true,'configured world product must retain its physical offer') end end local clean=command:Invoke('Snapshot') local cleanState=clean.OwnedPremiumFistsJSON=='[]' and clean.OwnedPremiumPetsJSON=='[]' and clean.PetInventoryJSON=='[]' and clean.Coins==0 and clean.SpinCredits==0 and clean.Honor==0 assert(cleanState,'purchase baseline is not clean') return H:JSONEncode({ok=configuredFists==3 and configuredPets==3 and configuredProducts==8 and honorProducts==4 and worldStands==6 and cleanState,configuredFists=configuredFists,configuredPets=configuredPets,configuredProducts=configuredProducts,honorProducts=honorProducts,worldStands=worldStands,cleanState=cleanState})

steps.label: catalog IDs and world purchase availability are truthful

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local gui=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=gui:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local fistDeadline=os.clock()+8 local fistWorldOk=false repeat task.wait(.1) fistWorldOk=true for _,fist in ipairs(cfg.PremiumFists) do local stand=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Interactables:FindFirstChild(fist.name..' Stand') if not (stand and stand:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true) then fistWorldOk=false end end until fistWorldOk or os.clock()>=fistDeadline for _,fist in ipairs(cfg.PremiumFists) do local stand=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Interactables:FindFirstChild(fist.name..' Stand') local detector=stand and stand:FindFirstChildOfClass('ClickDetector') local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(fist.gamePassId,Enum.InfoType.GamePass) end) local live=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 fistWorldOk=fistWorldOk and lookup and info.Name==fist.name and info.IsForSale==true and stand and detector and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and stand:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and stand:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==live end a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') local deadline=os.clock()+7 local ready=false repeat task.wait(.1) local shop=gui.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop ready=true for _,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local card=shop:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'ShopCard') local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'Action',true) if not (card and action and card:GetAttribute('PremiumPetPreviewReady')==true and action:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true) then ready=false end end until ready or os.clock()>=deadline local shop=gui.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local premiumOk,callbackOk,priceOk=true,true,true for _,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local card=shop:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'ShopCard') local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'Action',true) premiumOk=premiumOk and card~=nil and action~=nil and action.Active and action.Selectable and action.AutoButtonColor and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and action:GetAttribute('GamePassId')==pet.gamePassId and card:GetAttribute('PremiumPetPreviewReady')==true callbackOk=callbackOk and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true priceOk=priceOk and action:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and (tonumber(action:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')) or 0)>0 end local function validatePage(pageName) assert(a:Invoke('OpenShopPage',pageName)==true) local products={} for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do if (product.shopPage or 'Robux')==pageName then products[#products+1]=product end end local pageDeadline=os.clock()+8 local allResolved=false repeat task.wait(.1) allResolved=true for _,product in ipairs(products) do local card=shop:FindFirstChild(product.id..'ShopCard',true) allResolved=allResolved and card~=nil and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true end until allResolved or os.clock()>=pageDeadline local ok=allResolved for _,product in ipairs(products) do local card=shop:FindFirstChild(product.id..'ShopCard',true) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(product.id..'Action',true) local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(product.productId,Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local live=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 ok=ok and lookup and info.Name==product.displayName and info.IsForSale==true and card and action and card:GetAttribute('ProductId')==product.productId and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==live and action:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==live and action.Active and action.Selectable and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true and action.Text=='BUY' end return ok,#products end local productOk,productCount=validatePage('Robux') local honorOk,honorCount=validatePage('Honor') return H:JSONEncode({ok=fistWorldOk and premiumOk and callbackOk and priceOk and productOk and productCount==4 and honorOk and honorCount==4,fistWorldOk=fistWorldOk,premiumOk=premiumOk,callbackOk=callbackOk,priceOk=priceOk,productOk=productOk,productCount=productCount,honorOk=honorOk,honorCount=honorCount})

steps.label: premium and Robux controls are configured, priced, and wired

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expected={['Crimson Vanguard Fist']={id=1947838143,price=49},['Stormbreaker Fist']={id=1951036123,price=129},['Celestial Titan Fist']={id=1951054054,price=299}} local rows={} local ok=true for _,fist in ipairs(cfg.PremiumFists) do local e=expected[fist.name] local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(fist.gamePassId,Enum.InfoType.GamePass) end) local row={name=fist.name,id=fist.gamePassId,price=lookup and info.PriceInRobux or 0,forSale=lookup and info.IsForSale==true} row.ok=e~=nil and fist.gamePassId==e.id and fist.robux==e.price and lookup and info.Name==fist.name and info.IsForSale==true and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux)>0 rows[#rows+1]=row ok=ok and row.ok end assert(ok and #rows==3,'premium fist Marketplace metadata mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(rows)) return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,count=#rows,rows=rows})

steps.label: premium fist live Marketplace metadata matches configured passes

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local snapshot=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation:Invoke('Snapshot') local clean=snapshot.OwnedPremiumFistsJSON=='[]' and snapshot.OwnedPremiumPetsJSON=='[]' and snapshot.PetInventoryJSON=='[]' and snapshot.Coins==0 and snapshot.SpinCredits==0 assert(clean,'metadata/UI inspection mutated state') return H:JSONEncode({ok=clean,coins=snapshot.Coins,spins=snapshot.SpinCredits})

steps.label: catalog and metadata inspection cause no authoritative mutation
